newsitem.title: USA: S.D. 420 MW Big Stone power plant restart unknown.
newsitem.headline: S.D. 420 MW Big Stone power plant restart unknown.

text.p: Restart of the 420 megawatt (MW) coal-fired Big Stone generating station has not been set after it was shut Thursday to investigate a problem with its fire system, an on site spokesman said Friday.
"We've not found what caused the shutdown of the fire system," he said.
At the same time, engineers also discovered a problem with a transformer near the plant's generator, he said.
"We're looking for consultation," the official said, adding the manufacturer of the fire system was contacted to assist in correcting the situation.
The plant in Big Stone City, South Dakota, is operated and majority owned by Otter Tail Power Co. Northwestern Public Service and Montana-Dakota Utilities are other owners of the facility.
